knownLimitations.anchor: ## Known limitations (appended after KL-015-Q4); Change Log 0.1.8
knownLimitations.statement: Any MutationObserver record other than class/style attributes anywhere in the document during a fill's focus() refuses the fill as POST_FOCUS_CHANGED. That maps to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, and the whole session stops.
knownLimitations.classification: Capability boundary of the committed OBS-004/012A runner. Pilot-gating, conditional. Not a 015 defect; not fixed in 015.
knownLimitations.disclosedFixtureAdjustment: D5-1: the B1C-01 b1c-assert2 and joined assert-fail fixture mutations moved from focus to change. Assertions unchanged. Quinn ACK is conditional on execution and on run-manifest disclosure (w3-qa-ack02 §2 a-b).

knownLimitations.qaRecord: @qa carries it into the 015 gate record

knownLimitations.statement: While an append delivery is PENDING, recording-evidence from a runner that never applied v(n) (it reports v(n-1)) is refused STALE_FENCE, so the session keeps no recording.
knownLimitations.classification: Evidence, not settlement. Inferred by the architect, not executed. Not a 015 blocker.
knownLimitations.effectOn015: No AC, task, ledger row or Status change
knownLimitations.qaRecord: @qa carries it as a known limit (ruling §4 R1)

placements.anchor: AC-1 obligation a-d (after AC-1); T0 sub-item; File List docs/qa/evidence/studio-observed-authoring/pilot-focus-compatibility/; Change Log 0.3.7
placements.action: (a) For every pilot application and authored fill target, run a real-Chromium probe (D5 probe.mjs pattern; pinned Playwright; collector from the pilot runner dist recorded by digest; isolated world). A target passes when the fill raises no POST_FOCUS_CHANGED. Record value-free mutation types and attribute names. No secret is typed. (b) Any failure blocks that application's pilot until the check passes on a dist containing 009 AC-7 FOCUS-MUTATION-01. If it still fails after that, it goes to @architect. The block is never lifted by app edits, a tolerance or a skip. (c) Re-run on an application or dist change. (d) AC-4 row 'FOCUS-MUTATION-01', pending while any application is blocked or unchecked.
placements.completion_condition: Every pilot application passes on the pinned dist, with evidence recorded; never passed by omission

placements.anchor: AC-7 obligation a-f (after AUTHORED-ECHO-01); T4 sub-item; File List; Sequencing note; Change Log 0.3.13
placements.action: (a) @architect writes the exact rule before code. Direction: limit the post-focus check to the target's identity, eligibility, visibility, value and type, plus structural changes to its ancestors, with an explicit inert-attribute allowlist (candidates aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, aria-describedby, data-focus*). The allowlist and the count bound are @architect's call. At-most-once, the UNKNOWN_OUTCOME mapping for real target changes and the :738 pre-write checks are unchanged. No wire change; otherwise back to @architect. Security ack only if @architect classifies the change as a boundary change. (b) Fixture-tier positives: helper text, listbox or portal, allowlisted attributes, real-Chromium D5 matrix. Negatives: the 3 existing refusals by name, target replaced, ancestor removed or moved, non-allowlisted target attribute; joined unknown2 unchanged. (c) Joined helper-text regression; the 015 D5-1 fixtures are left as they are. (d) Canaries and AC-11 proofs hold; dist rebuilt and digest per AC-12 i, which may be shared with AUTHORED-ECHO-01. (e) benchmark.json focusMutationRefusedFills per run, 0 explicit, inside denominators. If not landed when T4 is due, T4 waits for a written @pm+@architect record, and a nonzero count is disclosed in the 010 AC-4 row. @po recommends one on-focus autocomplete or helper-text case in the @qa corpus. (f) The landed digest feeds the 010 AC-1 re-check.
placements.completion_condition: a-f evidenced before the first real-model call of T4, or the written @pm+@architect record of e. Never passed by omission. The AC-7 gate, corpus rule and thresholds are unchanged. Not added to the 2026-10-15 OBS-011 start list.

placements.anchor: AC-11 obligation R1 a-e (after AC-11 k); T5 sub-item; File List; Sequencing note; Change Log 0.3.13
placements.action: (a) A failing embedded-PG probe IT (GuidedServiceTransportFaultIT helpers): a PENDING delivery plus recording-evidence at v(n-1) reproduces STALE_FENCE. If it does not reproduce, record that and close as not reproduced. (b) @architect confirms in writing that recording-evidence is non-consuming in L1's sense. Then accept exactly {v(n), v(n-1)} while pending, using L1's single derivation (verifyLifecycle/sameIdentity or one shared helper). Without a pending delivery the route is byte-for-byte today's. Owner, fence, scope, versions and idempotency checks are unchanged; requireAcknowledged stays on consuming routes; no runner, dist, schema or migration change. Without the confirmation, nothing is implemented and e applies. (c) Tests: v(n-1) and v(n) accepted while pending; n-2, n+1, foreign contextId and foreign fence refused STALE_FENCE with no write; no-pending control refuses v(n-1); delivery stays PENDING; mutation check (drop v(n-1) and case 1 fails). (d) Joined owner or browser loss at v(n-1): the session ends, the recording settles, plays and seeks. (e) Until a-d are done or closed under a, the OBS-010 AC-4 record carries KL-015-R1 as a named known limit.
placements.completion_condition: a-d evidenced, or closed as not reproduced under a, or e disclosed if @architect declines b. Never passed by omission. Edits start only after 015 Done (L1 lands there).

autoDecisions: [AUTO-DECISION] Fix R1 or only disclose it? -> Fix in 009 AC-11, probe first (reason: a lost recording on owner loss removes evidence where diagnosis needs it; the ruling's binding is ready and cheap; it stays disclosed until landed).
[AUTO-DECISION] Focus-guard allowlist contents and record-count bound -> left to @architect; Quinn's candidates recorded as direction (reason: a safety design call, not product scope).

[AUTO-DECISION] Security & Compliance acknowledgement for the focus change -> only if @architect classifies it as a privacy or security boundary (reason: it is an at-most-once guard, not a data boundary).
[AUTO-DECISION] Pilot check criterion -> no POST_FOCUS_CHANGED on the pilot's pinned dist (reason: valid before and after the 009 change; value-free mutation records kept for diagnosis).

[AUTO-DECISION] Placement of the fix before the benchmark -> 009 AC-7, mirroring AUTHORED-ECHO-01 (reason: protects the D-C measurement; 009 owns runner, dist digest, canaries, at-most-once and benchmark accounting).
